title: Uniform asymptotics for a multidimensional renewal risk model with random number of delayed claims and multivariate subexponentiality
summary: In this paper we examine a multivariate risk model, with common renewal counting process, constant interest rate, and each claim vector is accompanied by a random number of delayed claim vectors. The interest is focused on the asymptotic behavior of the entrance probability of the discounted aggregate claims into some rare-sets, over a finite and an infinite time horizon. Our results study thecase where the main claims and the delayed claims have in some sense, asymptotic equivalent tails, but also the case where the delayed claims are negligible with comparisons with the main claims.
